svg.text: Phases 2, 3 and 4 — one node, three stages, 89 subtasks
Horizontal position denotes dependency depth, not calendar time. Every arrow is a dependency the phase plans state.
The two phases the milestone plan calls parallel are parallel until their deployed ends, where each needs the other:
the Room cannot show ego's own vehicle B without Phase 3's detector inside the image, and Phase 3's last three
readings are taken off the log that Room produces. Group 4.12 additionally needs Phase 1's bench and radio node.
